SinkWatch | Seeing the Ground Move from Space
I'm Muhammad Asif, a recent Computer Science graduate, AI engineer and Research Assistant at a space tech Lab , working on remote sensing. Cities worldwide are sinking as groundwater is overpumped. SinkWatch uses NASA's new NISAR L-band radar to map which neighbourhoods are sinking, how fast, and who is at risk. From Quetta to Jakarta and Mexico City: satellite insight before the cracks appear. Built solo from Pakistan.
